ti.title: ኦ ጐይታ ውዕለትካ
ti.lyrics:
[[chorus]]
ብሐዋርያት ጌርካ ብዙሕ ምሂርካኒ
ስለ ኃጢአተይ ሞይትካ ሕይወት’ውን ሂብካኒ (2)
[[/chorus]]

ኦ ጐይታ ውዕለትካ ተኣምርካ ድንቂ’ዩ
ኣምላኻዊ ቃልካ ስምካ ሕይወት ኢዩ (2)

ኣጸናኒዕካኒ በጺሕካ ኣብ ሓዘነይ
ኣጆኻ ዝወደይ ኢልካ ዘልዓልካኒ
ኣጆኺ ’ዛ ጓለይ ኢልካ ዘልዓልካኒ

ሓቀኛ ረዳኢ ወገነይ ንስኻ
ጐይታ ካብ ወለደይ ትበልጽ ንስኻ (2)

ስምካ መግበይ ኮይኑ እጸግብ ጸዊዐ
ፍጹም’ውን ይምካሕ ፍቕርኻ ጥዒመ (2)

ti_ro.title: O goyta w'letka
ti_ro.lyrics:
[[chorus]]
Amlakhawi qalka smka hywet iyu (2)
[[/chorus]]

O goyta wletka teamrka dnqi’yu
Bhawaryat gerka bzuh mhirkani
Sle hatiatey moytka hywet’wn hibkani (2)
Atsenanikani betsihka ab hazeney
Ajokha zwedey ilka zelalkani
Ajokhi ’za gwaley ilka zelalkani
Kab zeytef hawi kab mot zewtsakhani
Nakha zkheflo goyta ntay aloni(2)
Haqenya redai wegeney nskha
Goyta kab weledey tbelts nskha (2)
Mmenan nmkah goyta bakha’yu
Zeytqyer amlakh smka kbur'yu(2)
Smka megbey koynu tsegb tsewia
Ftsum’wn ymkah fqrkha time (2)
Bsemay bmdri bnefsi bsga
Bakha mkah alfa weomega (2)
